## Deviations
- TUI required two Enter keypresses per submission (same as F17); prompts sent single-line with identical field content.
- Steps 2, 3, 5, 8: the recipe's own read-ish commands (`sleep`, `pgrep`) triggered approval prompts; approved **once** each (option 1) because the measurement requires the command to run. Step 6 write attempt was denied via Esc per instructions — Esc canceled the whole turn (`✱ Canceled. What should Devin do?`), so a one-line follow-up prompt was sent to capture the parent's verbatim report (`Canceled due to user interrupt`).
- Step 7 needed no follow-up: the parent called `read_subagent` on its own and pasted the report.
- `KW_SK` env var and `cd /tmp` did NOT persist between sidekick turns even though the shell id `44f5c9` was constant — the sidekick itself reported the shell state as reset/recreated. The detached `sleep 600` (PID 47397) survived across turns and `/compact`, but had exited by the post-resume check (600 s elapsed).
- After `/model adaptive` mid-session the sidekick tool left the live catalog (call not even attempted: "unavailable in the current tool catalog"); after switching back to fusion it worked again and the same sidekick (SWE-2 Medium, same shell) answered.
- tmux `kw1060-sk` ended via `/exit` then `kill-session`. `/tmp/kw-fusion-probe` left in place; no sk-write-*.txt files were ever created.
